question: Which navigation satellite did India launch in January 2025 to enhance its NavIC system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NVS-02**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **NVS-02** is the **second satellite **in the **Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC) series**, aimed at enhancing India's regional navigation capabilities.
 
• It was launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (**ISRO**) in **January 2025 **using the GSLV ro
